items.name: A Quarterly Report Written at 3 AM
items.flavorText: Numbers by moonlight.

items.name: iPad Pro Tablet

items.name: Apple Pencil 2nd Gen

items.name: Paperlike Matte Screen Protector

items.name: Unlimited Layer Count (Modifier)
items.flavorText: Layer 214, named 'final_v3_ACTUALFINAL.'

items.name: Quick Reference Image Importer
items.flavorText: For hands. Always, specifically, for hands.

items.name: Auto-Generating Color Palettes
items.flavorText: Picks better colors than you would have, and you know it.

items.name: Lofi Chill Drawing Playlist

items.name: A Drawing Tablet, Wire Fraying at the Base
items.flavorText: Works if you hold it at exactly the right angle.

items.name: Dual Monitor, One Just for References
items.flavorText: Forty browser tabs of the same pose, slightly different lighting.

items.name: Infinitely Deep Undo History (Modifier)
items.flavorText: Ctrl+Z, back to a version you liked better, three hours ago.

items.name: A Brush Pack You Bought and Never Opened
items.flavorText: $12 well spent, apparently, just not on brushes you use.

items.name: Software Crashing Before You Saved
items.flavorText: Four hours of work. Ctrl+S, a concept you've since embraced.

items.name: A Sketch That Looked Better Before Line Art
items.flavorText: The rough version had a certain magic. It's gone now.

items.name: Time-Lapse Recording On, No Pressure (Modifier)
items.flavorText: Every hesitant stroke, preserved forever, for an audience of six.

items.name: A Pinterest Board, 900 Images Deep
items.flavorText: The algorithm knows your art style better than you do now.

items.name: An Art Block, Right on Deadline
items.flavorText: Every idea feels wrong. The clock disagrees with waiting it out.

items.name: A Genuine Burst of Creative Flow
items.flavorText: Four hours pass. It feels like twenty minutes. Rare, precious.

items.name: Cat Walking Across the Tablet
items.flavorText: Adds an unplanned, chaotic new layer to the piece.

items.name: Cozy Desk Lamp, Warm Light Only
items.flavorText: Sets a mood. Ruins your color accuracy completely.

items.name: Stylus With Interchangeable Nibs
items.flavorText: Feels like a fine pen. Or a chisel.

items.name: Custom Shortcut Setup
items.flavorText: Keys remembered. Time saved.

items.name: Saving Thirty Versions, Naming None
items.flavorText: final_final_REAL_final.

items.name: A Reference Photo That Nails It
items.flavorText: Half the work, already done.

items.name: A Library Corner Nobody Knows About
items.flavorText: Quiet, sunlit, and yours until someone else finds it.

items.name: A Coffee Shop, One Outlet Left
items.flavorText: You got there at the exact right minute. A miracle.

items.name: Your Bed, a Terrible Idea
items.flavorText: Horizontal within four minutes. Asleep within twelve.

items.name: A Study Room, Booked for Exactly One Hour
items.flavorText: Someone's already knocking at minute fifty-eight.

items.name: An Iced Coffee, Second of the Day
items.flavorText: Not a great sign. Not stopping either.

items.name: An Energy Drink, Way Too Late at Night
items.flavorText: Focused now. Regretting it at 3am, specifically.

items.name: Snacks That Are Secretly the Whole Plan
items.flavorText: The studying was optional. The snacks were not.

items.name: A Perfectly Balanced Meal, Actually Eaten
items.flavorText: Protein, vegetables, and genuine self-respect.

items.name: A Lofi Playlist, Four Hours Long
items.flavorText: The background noise of an entire generation's homework.

items.name: Instrumental Movie Scores, Oddly Motivating
items.flavorText: Suddenly every essay feels like a heist is happening.

items.name: No Music, Just Anxiety
items.flavorText: Silence, and the loud sound of your own thoughts.

items.name: A Playlist That's Somehow All Ads Now
items.flavorText: Four songs, then a car insurance jingle. Repeat.

items.name: A Study Group That Actually Studies
items.flavorText: Rare. Precious. Gone by the third meeting.

items.name: A Practice Exam, Going Better Than Expected
items.flavorText: A small, genuine glimmer of hope.

items.name: A Deadline, Suddenly Very Real
items.flavorText: The most reliable motivator known to any student.

items.name: A Productivity App, Guilt-Tripping You Into Focus
items.flavorText: A little cartoon plant dies if you check your phone.

items.name: Color-Coded Notes, Never Actually Reread
items.flavorText: Beautiful. Organized. Purely decorative, in the end.

items.name: Phone, Face Down, Off (Modifier)
items.flavorText: The single most powerful productivity tool that exists.

items.name: A Group Chat Notification, Impossible to Ignore
items.flavorText: You just have to check it. You always just have to check it.

items.name: 'Just One Episode' Turning Into Four
items.flavorText: The textbook remains exactly where you left it.

items.name: A Roommate Who Won't Stop Talking
items.flavorText: Fascinating story. Terrible timing.

items.name: Reorganizing Your Desk Instead of Working
items.flavorText: Extremely productive. Completely beside the point.

items.name: A Genuine Breakthrough, Everything Clicks
items.flavorText: The concept that made no sense for weeks, suddenly obvious.

items.name: Falling Asleep on Page Two
items.flavorText: Woke up an hour later with a highlighter mark across your face.

items.name: Front Row, Close Enough to See Everything
items.flavorText: You will hear about this for the rest of your life.

items.name: Nosebleed Section, Binoculars Required
items.flavorText: The band is technically visible. Technically.

items.name: General Admission, Fighting for Space
items.flavorText: Elbows out. No regrets. Worth it.

items.name: A Surprise VIP Upgrade
items.flavorText: Nobody knows why. Nobody's asking questions.

items.name: An Opener Nobody Came For, Secretly Great
items.flavorText: You're now a fan. This was not the plan.

items.name: An Opener That Runs Twenty Minutes Long
items.flavorText: Great for them. Rough for everyone's patience.

items.name: No Opener, Straight to the Main Act
items.flavorText: No warmup needed. Straight to business.

items.name: A Crowd That Sings Every Word
items.flavorText: The artist barely has to sing at this point.

items.name: Someone Way Too Tall Standing in Front of You
items.flavorText: You've seen approximately one third of this concert.

items.name: A Mosh Pit You Did Not Sign Up For
items.flavorText: You came to stand still. The crowd disagreed.

items.name: Strangers Who Become Friends by the Encore
items.flavorText: You'll never see them again. You'll never forget them either.

items.name: The Encore Everyone Begged For
items.flavorText: Lighters up. Phone flashlights up. Voices completely gone.

items.name: A Surprise Guest Walks Onstage
items.flavorText: The crowd loses its mind before the first note even lands.

items.name: The Sound Cutting Out Mid-Song
items.flavorText: A brief, deeply awkward a cappella moment.

items.name: They Play the One Song You Wanted
items.flavorText: You didn't think they'd actually do it. They did it.

items.name: A Confetti Cannon, Way Too Much Confetti
items.flavorText: Still finding it in your shoes a week later.

items.name: A $19 Beer, Purchased Anyway
items.flavorText: You knew. You bought it regardless.

items.name: Parking Somehow Worse Than the Show Itself
items.flavorText: A forty-minute ordeal that nearly overshadowed the encore.

items.name: A Setlist You Somehow Predicted
items.flavorText: You called it. Nobody believed you. You were right.

items.name: Losing Your Voice by the Third Song
items.flavorText: Worth it. Regrettable on Monday's work call.

items.name: A T-Shirt You'll Wear Exactly Twice
items.flavorText: $45 well spent, on a shirt destined for the drawer.

items.name: Getting Home at 2am, Ears Still Ringing
items.flavorText: Worth every minute of the commute back.

items.name: A Phone Battery Dead by Intermission
items.flavorText: You'll have to actually just watch the rest of it.

items.name: Meeting the Band After, Completely Speechless
items.flavorText: You had a whole speech planned. None of it came out.

items.name: Sunset Set on the Main Stage
items.flavorText: Golden light. Thousands of voices. One song.

items.name: Muddy Boots and Sunscreen Combo
items.flavorText: The festival uniform.

items.name: Flower Crowns and Glow Sticks
items.flavorText: A glittering, cheerful sea.

items.name: Center Balcony, Perfect Acoustics
items.flavorText: Every note arrives just for you.

items.name: Cheap Seats With a Pillar in the Way
items.flavorText: You'll hear it. Just not see it.

items.name: Warm-Up Piece by a Student Composer
items.flavorText: Brave, brief, and a little bit brilliant.

items.name: A Hushed Audience, Politely Coughing
items.flavorText: Silence, punctuated by lozenge wrappers.

items.name: Someone Clapping Between Movements
items.flavorText: A faux pas heard round the hall.

items.name: The Violin Solo That Stops Time
items.flavorText: Everyone forgets to breathe.

items.name: Cell Phone Ring Mid-Adagio
items.flavorText: Ringtone: a disco remix.

items.name: Dressing Up Slightly Too Much
items.flavorText: Better than too little.

items.name: A Program Book Nobody Reads
items.flavorText: Glossy. Unopened. Kept forever.

items.name: A Vintage Band Tee, Actually Your Size
items.flavorText: The holy grail of secondhand shopping, located.

items.name: A Leather Jacket, Broken In by Someone Else
items.flavorText: All the character, none of the wait.

items.name: A Mystery Stain, Location Unclear
items.flavorText: You'll notice it later. In public. Too late.

items.name: Still Has the Original Tags On
items.flavorText: Someone's regret is your excellent decision.

items.name: A Missing Button, Right Where You'd Notice It
items.flavorText: Fixable. Definitely will not be fixed.

items.name: $3.99, Marked Down Twice
items.flavorText: The math doesn't matter. The math never mattered.

items.name: Mysteriously Overpriced for a Used Item
items.flavorText: It's secondhand. It is also, somehow, $40.

items.name: Half-Off Yellow Tag Day (Modifier)
items.flavorText: You planned your whole week around this.

items.name: A Weird Smell You'll Deal With Later
items.flavorText: Three washes in, still slightly there.

items.name: A Denim Jacket, Perfectly Faded
items.flavorText: Decades of sun did what no store could replicate.

items.name: A Ceramic Mug, Someone's Grandma Definitely Owned
items.flavorText: It has seen things. Good things, probably.

items.name: A Book With Someone's Handwritten Notes Inside
items.flavorText: A whole stranger's inner monologue, included for free.

items.name: An Entire Bin of Unsorted Chaos
items.flavorText: Somewhere in here is treasure. Also, definitely, trash.

items.name: Digging for Twenty Minutes, Finding Nothing
items.flavorText: The classic thrifting tax. Paid in full.

items.name: The One Rack Nobody Else Checked
items.flavorText: Yours now. All of it. Yours.

items.name: A Genuine Designer Piece, Unpriced Correctly
items.flavorText: The tag says $8. The internet says otherwise.

items.name: A Going-Out Top, Slightly 2013
items.flavorText: It's coming back. It has to be coming back.

items.name: Grandpa-Core Cardigan Energy
items.flavorText: Extremely cozy. Extremely, correctly, unbothered.

items.name: An Outfit That Somehow Works Together
items.flavorText: None of it matched on the rack. All of it matches now.

items.name: A Costume Piece, Repurposed as Real Clothes
items.flavorText: Nobody needs to know it was originally a cape.

items.name: A Tote Bag, Already Full
items.flavorText: You've stopped counting what's actually in it.

items.name: A Record You Don't Own a Player For
items.flavorText: A future problem. A beautiful, future problem.

items.name: Haggling Over a Dollar, Winning Anyway
items.flavorText: A small, meaningless, deeply satisfying victory.

items.name: A Perfect Fit, First Try, No Alterations
items.flavorText: The rarest outcome in all of secondhand shopping.

items.name: A Venue With a Perfect Sunset Backdrop
items.flavorText: Every photo looks professionally lit. It wasn't.

items.name: A Barn, Rustically Overpriced
items.flavorText: String lights and reclaimed wood, at a genuinely alarming rate.

items.name: Rain on the Outdoor Ceremony, Unplanned
items.flavorText: Everyone says it's good luck. Nobody actually believes that.

items.name: A Backyard, Genuinely Pulled Off Beautifully
items.flavorText: Somebody's uncle rented a tent and changed everything.

items.name: A Dress That Fits Exactly Right
items.flavorText: Eleven fittings later, finally, precisely correct.

items.name: A Bridesmaid Dress Nobody Asked to Wear Twice
items.flavorText: Bold color choice. Bold, singular, never-repeated choice.

items.name: A Tux, Slightly Too Tight After Dinner
items.flavorText: Fit perfectly at the fitting. Betrayed by the second plate.

items.name: Matching Something, Somehow Not Cheesy (Modifier)
items.flavorText: A coordinated detail that actually, against all odds, works.

items.name: A Best Man Speech That Actually Lands
items.flavorText: Funny, heartfelt, and mercifully under five minutes.

items.name: A Speech That Runs Fifteen Minutes Too Long
items.flavorText: Started as a toast. Became a full biography.

items.name: A Toast That Makes Everyone Cry, Good Tears
items.flavorText: Every table reaching for a napkin at the same time.

items.name: An Ex Mentioned by Accident Mid-Toast
items.flavorText: The room goes very, very quiet for exactly one second.

items.name: The First Dance, Actually Rehearsed
items.flavorText: Weeks of secret lessons, finally paying off in front of everyone.

items.name: The Bouquet Toss, Mild Chaos
items.flavorText: More competitive than anyone expected it to be.

items.name: A Surprise Performance From a Guest
items.flavorText: Nobody knew they could sing like that. Nobody.

items.name: The Cake Cutting, Slightly Too Aggressive
items.flavorText: That was not a gentle smash. Everyone saw it.

items.name: An Open Bar, Generously Timed
items.flavorText: The reception's real MVP, and everyone knows it.

items.name: A Seating Chart Feud, Diplomatically Resolved
items.flavorText: Two families, one table, careful diplomacy.

items.name: The DJ Reading the Room Perfectly
items.flavorText: Every song choice, correct, all night long.

items.name: A Relative Who Causes a Small Scene
items.flavorText: Right on schedule, around the third glass of wine.

items.name: An RSVP That Never Actually Arrived
items.flavorText: The seating chart's one, singular, ongoing mystery.

items.name: A Dance Floor That Never Empties
items.flavorText: Somebody's grandmother is still out there at midnight.

items.name: A Vow That Gets a Genuine Laugh
items.flavorText: Not planned as a joke. Landed as one anyway.

items.name: Weather That Cooperates, Against All Forecasts
items.flavorText: The forecast said 80% rain. Not one drop showed up.

items.name: Ceremony Barefoot at the Waterline
items.flavorText: Toes in the surf. Vows in the breeze.

items.name: Flowy Dress That Loves the Breeze
items.flavorText: Every gust is a mini photo shoot.

items.name: Lantern Release Over the Ocean
items.flavorText: Drifting wishes, glowing skyward.

items.name: Sand in the Cake
items.flavorText: Crunchy, but sentimental.

items.name: Tide Coming In Mid-Vows
items.flavorText: Ankle-deep commitment.

items.name: String-Lit Dance Under the Rafters
items.flavorText: Twinkling lights. Slightly dusty.

items.name: Hay Allergy in the Front Row
items.flavorText: Sniffles, sneezes, romance.

items.name: Quiet Courthouse Steps
items.flavorText: No fuss. Great acoustics.

items.name: Mountain Overlook, Just the Two of You
items.flavorText: Witnesses: a marmot.

items.name: Sharp Suit and a Simple Dress
items.flavorText: Elegant, effortless, packable.

items.name: Vows Written on the Way There
items.flavorText: Raw. Real. Slightly typo'd.

items.name: Celebration Dinner for Two
items.flavorText: A candle, a corner table, a big sigh.

items.name: Witness Recruited From the Hallway
items.flavorText: A stranger named Carl.

items.name: Marriage Office Closes for Lunch
items.flavorText: A very long wait, then a very short ceremony.

items.name: Photo on the Steps With a Stranger's Camera
items.flavorText: Slightly crooked. Perfect.

items.name: Grand Stone Hall With Chandeliers
items.flavorText: Sparkle overhead, echoes everywhere.

items.name: Long Cathedral Veil
items.flavorText: Six feet of drama.

items.name: Trumpet Fanfare at the Entrance
items.flavorText: Regal, loud, and slightly over the top.

items.name: Drafty Halls, Shivering Guests
items.flavorText: Ancient stone. Modern chills.

items.name: Guests Lost in the Turrets
items.flavorText: A search party for the cake.

items.name: A Gas Station With Surprisingly Good Food
items.flavorText: Nobody believes you until they try it themselves.

items.name: A Station With One Working Pump, of Course Yours
items.flavorText: Every other pump works fine. Not this one.

items.name: A Clean, Fully Stocked Bathroom
items.flavorText: A genuine, five-star road trip miracle.

items.name: A Bathroom You Regret Immediately
items.flavorText: In and out in record time. No further comment.

items.name: A Line for the Bathroom, Longer Than the Drive So Far
items.flavorText: Everyone had the same idea at the same exit.

items.name: Gas Station Sushi, Bold Choice
items.flavorText: A decision made under duress, three hours from anywhere.

items.name: A Perfectly Stale Gas Station Donut
items.flavorText: Purchased anyway. Eaten anyway. No regrets, mostly.

items.name: Local Beef Jerky, Genuinely Excellent
items.flavorText: You buy three more bags for the rest of the trip.

items.name: A Slushie in a Concerning Neon Color
items.flavorText: Blue Raspberry, allegedly. Tastes like victory.

items.name: World's Largest Ball of Twine (Modifier)
items.flavorText: A forty-minute detour, fully justified in retrospect.

items.name: A Roadside Dinosaur Statue, Inexplicably
items.flavorText: No context given. None needed.

items.name: A 'Historic' Marker Nobody Reads
items.flavorText: Something happened here in 1861, apparently.

items.name: A Diner That's Been There Since 1962
items.flavorText: The pie case alone justifies the whole detour.

items.name: A Rest Stop Vending Machine, Eats Your Dollar
items.flavorText: A tax paid at every single rest stop in America.

items.name: Perfect Timing, Exactly When You Needed It
items.flavorText: Gas light on, bladder full, exit sign appearing right on cue.

items.name: Stopping Fifteen Minutes Before You Actually Needed To
items.flavorText: Now you'll need another one in twenty minutes anyway.

items.name: A Twenty-Minute Stop That Becomes an Hour
items.flavorText: Nobody remembers how. Everyone's fine with it.

items.name: A Scenic Overlook, Worth the Detour
items.flavorText: Everyone gets out. Everyone takes the same photo.

items.name: A Souvenir Shop Full of Regrettable Magnets
items.flavorText: You buy one anyway. You always buy one anyway.

items.name: Free Samples at the Local Fudge Shop
items.flavorText: You've had six samples. You've bought nothing. Yet.

items.name: A Bathroom Key Attached to a Hubcap
items.flavorText: Impossible to lose. Impossible to forget you're holding it.

items.name: A Coffee That's Been Sitting Since Morning
items.flavorText: Technically still coffee. Technically.

items.name: A Perfectly Timed Bathroom Break, No Line
items.flavorText: In, out, back on the road in ninety seconds flat.

items.name: A Station With Every Snack You Wanted
items.flavorText: A rest stop that feels like it was built specifically for you.

items.name: A Prank So Good It's Still Talked About Years Later
items.flavorText: Legendary status, achieved on a Tuesday.

items.name: Saran Wrap Over the Doorway
items.flavorText: A classic for a reason. The reason is chaos.

items.name: Fake Spider in the Cereal Box
items.flavorText: A scream at 7am. Worth losing the friendship, briefly.

items.name: A Whoopee Cushion, Deployed With Precision
items.flavorText: Timing is everything. This timing was perfect.

items.name: Swapping the Sugar for Salt
items.flavorText: A betrayal, discovered one sip of coffee at a time.

items.name: A Coworker Who Takes It Way Too Personally
items.flavorText: It was a rubber duck on their desk. They're still mad.

items.name: A Perfect, Genuine Scream
items.flavorText: Recorded. Replayed. Never forgotten.

items.name: Getting Caught Before You Even Finish Setting Up
items.flavorText: They walked in three minutes early. Plan: over.

items.name: A Prank That Backfires Completely
items.flavorText: Somehow, you're the one covered in flour now.

items.name: The Target Who Never Suspects a Thing
items.flavorText: Blissfully, perfectly unaware, right up to the end.

items.name: The Target Who's Onto You Immediately
items.flavorText: They knew the second you said good morning too nicely.

items.name: A Sibling, Fair Game Year-Round
items.flavorText: No statute of limitations applies here.

items.name: The Boss, Bold and Possibly Unwise
items.flavorText: A career risk, taken purely for comedic value.

items.name: An Elaborate Fake Email Announcement
items.flavorText: Company-wide. Convincing. Deeply, deeply unauthorized.

items.name: Rearranging Every Item on Their Desk by One Inch
items.flavorText: Nothing's missing. Something feels deeply wrong.

items.name: Getting Pranked Right Back, Immediately
items.flavorText: They saw it coming and had a counter ready.

items.name: A Long Con, Planned Since March
items.flavorText: Weeks of setup for one perfect, singular moment.

items.name: A Prank Nobody Even Notices Happened
items.flavorText: All that effort. Complete, total silence.

items.name: Laughing So Hard You Give It Away Early
items.flavorText: The plan was solid. Your poker face was not.

items.name: A Genuinely Impressed 'Okay, That Was Good'
items.flavorText: The rarest, most respected reaction of all.

items.name: A Fake Lottery Ticket Scratch-Off
items.flavorText: A full minute of false hope, expertly manufactured.

items.name: Someone Who Holds a Grudge Until Next April
items.flavorText: 364 days of quiet, simmering plans for revenge.

items.name: A Group Effort, Perfectly Coordinated
items.flavorText: Six people, one lie, zero cracks in the story.

items.name: It Somehow Becomes a Whole Office Legend
items.flavorText: New hires hear about this one in their first week.

items.name: A Boss With Three Increasingly Unfair Phases
items.flavorText: Phase one was a lie. Phases two and three know it.

items.name: A Boss That's Secretly Just a Big Rat
items.flavorText: All that buildup, for this.

items.name: A Final Boss Easier Than the Second-to-Last
items.flavorText: The game peaked one level too early.

items.name: A Genuinely Terrifying Final Form
items.flavorText: It was humanoid a minute ago. It is not humanoid anymore.

items.name: An Arena That Collapses Halfway Through
items.flavorText: The floor is now also the enemy.

items.name: A Tiny Arena With No Room to Dodge
items.flavorText: The design team clearly hated you personally.

items.name: Lava, Obviously
items.flavorText: It wouldn't be a boss arena without it.

items.name: An Arena That's Just a Featureless Grey Room
items.flavorText: The budget, it seems, ran out here.

items.name: An Absolutely Unhinged Boss Theme
items.flavorText: You'll be humming this one for weeks against your will.

items.name: Music That Cuts Out Right Before the Final Hit
items.flavorText: Dead silence, for maximum dramatic effect.

items.name: A Calm Piano Piece for a Deeply Sad Final Boss
items.flavorText: You don't want to win anymore. You do it anyway.

items.name: Elevator Music, Somehow, for a Dragon
items.flavorText: A baffling, genuinely funny composer choice.

items.name: Learning the Attack Pattern After Death #12
items.flavorText: The dance finally makes sense. Barely. Finally.

items.name: A Cheese Strategy You're Not Proud Of
items.flavorText: It worked. That's all that matters, technically.

items.name: A Perfect No-Hit Run
items.flavorText: Flawless. Unbelievable. Immediately screenshotted.

items.name: Button-Mashing and Hoping
items.flavorText: A strategy. Technically. Barely.

items.name: A Summon Sign You're Slightly Ashamed to Use
items.flavorText: Help arrives. Pride quietly leaves the room.

items.name: A Legendary Weapon Drop
items.flavorText: Forty deaths, finally justified in one glowing item.

items.name: A Cutscene That Explains Nothing
items.flavorText: You have more questions now than before the fight.

items.name: Just Fifty Gold and a 'Thanks'
items.flavorText: That took an hour. This is the reward. This is it.

items.name: A New Game Plus Unlock
items.flavorText: You're doing this all again, harder, on purpose.

items.name: An Achievement Popup, Deeply Satisfying
items.flavorText: A tiny ding of digital validation. Perfect.

items.name: A Health Bar With a Sneaky Second Bar Underneath
items.flavorText: You thought it was over. It was not, in fact, over.

items.name: The Controller-Throwing Difficulty Spike
items.flavorText: One moment, zero warning, total chaos.

items.name: A First-Round Pick Who Actually Delivers
items.flavorText: The safest pick on the board, for once actually safe.

items.name: A Sleeper Pick Nobody Saw Coming
items.flavorText: Round nine. Everyone laughed. Nobody's laughing now.

items.name: A Bust You Drafted Way Too High
items.flavorText: Round two money for a bench-warmer's season.

items.name: Drafting Your Own Team's Players Out of Loyalty
items.flavorText: Emotionally satisfying. Statistically questionable.

items.name: A Waiver Wire Pickup That Wins You the Season
items.flavorText: Free. Unclaimed. Suddenly your MVP.

items.name: A Perfectly Timed Trade
items.flavorText: Both sides think they won. Only one of you actually did.

items.name: A Trade You Immediately Regret
items.flavorText: Sent thirty seconds ago. Regretted twenty-nine seconds ago.

items.name: Autodrafting Because You Forgot the Time
items.flavorText: The algorithm now runs your entire season.

items.name: A League With Genuinely Fun Punishment Rules
items.flavorText: Last place gets a real, humiliating consequence. As it should.

items.name: The Guy Who Never Sets His Lineup
items.flavorText: Same bench players, week fourteen in a row.

items.name: A Rivalry That's Gotten Weirdly Personal
items.flavorText: It's a game about strangers throwing a ball. This is not about that anymore.

items.name: A Commissioner Who Takes It Too Seriously
items.flavorText: Rule changes. Formal warnings. A whole constitution, typed up.

items.name: A Group Chat That's 90% Trash Talk
items.flavorText: The other 10% is also trash talk, just with screenshots.

items.name: A Championship Win, Finally, After Years
items.flavorText: Screenshotted immediately. Framed, emotionally speaking.

items.name: Losing by 0.2 Points, Devastatingly
items.flavorText: A missed extra point away from an entirely different Monday.

items.name: Last Place, and the Punishment That Comes With It
items.flavorText: The custom jersey has already been ordered.

items.name: A Bench Player Outscoring Your Whole Starting Lineup
items.flavorText: The lineup decision that will haunt you all week.

items.name: An Injury Report Checked Obsessively
items.flavorText: Refreshed forty times before kickoff. Just in case.

items.name: A Bye Week You Completely Forgot About
items.flavorText: Zero points from your star player. A self-inflicted wound.

items.name: A Last-Second Lineup Swap, Correctly Called
items.flavorText: Ninety seconds before kickoff, and it paid off completely.

items.name: Trash Talk That Goes Slightly Too Far
items.flavorText: It's just a game, someone says, unconvincingly.

items.name: A Trade Veto, Controversially Upheld
items.flavorText: The league voted. The league was, allegedly, right.

items.name: Checking Scores During a Family Dinner
items.flavorText: Under the table. Nobody's fooled. Everybody's done it.

items.name: A Perfect Draft, No Regrets, Somehow
items.flavorText: Every single pick, in hindsight, exactly right.

items.name: A Song You Know Every Word To, Unironically
items.flavorText: No screen needed. You've known this one since 2009.

items.name: A Duet That Actually Sounds Good
items.flavorText: Rehearsed in secret. Landed perfectly in public.

items.name: A Song Way Outside Your Vocal Range, Chosen Anyway
items.flavorText: Confidence: 100%. Pitch: negotiable.

items.name: The One Song Everyone Requests You Sing
items.flavorText: You've done it forty times. It works every single time.

items.name: A Full Commitment to the Dance Moves
items.flavorText: Nobody asked for choreography. You provided it anyway.

items.name: Forgetting the Words Two Lines In
items.flavorText: The screen is right there. It is not helping.

items.name: An Unexpectedly Incredible Falsetto
items.flavorText: Nobody knew. Including, until now, you.

items.name: Reading Every Word Off the Screen, Barely Singing
items.flavorText: Technically participating. Spiritually just narrating.

items.name: A Crowd That Sings the Chorus With You
items.flavorText: Suddenly it's not a solo anymore. Better this way.

items.name: One Person Who Refuses to Participate All Night
items.flavorText: Present. Watching. Judging, probably.

items.name: Someone Who Takes This Way Too Seriously
items.flavorText: Warm-ups. A setlist. This is a hobby now.

items.name: A Standing Ovation for a Genuinely Bad Performance
items.flavorText: The effort was there. The pitch was not. Doesn't matter.

items.name: Liquid Courage, Exactly the Right Amount
items.flavorText: Confident, not sloppy. A rare, perfect balance.

items.name: One Drink Too Many, Regrettable Song Choice Incoming
items.flavorText: This is how the eleven-minute prog rock ballad happens.

items.name: A Round Bought for the Whole Room
items.flavorText: An instant, universally beloved decision.

items.name: Water, Because Someone Has to Drive
items.flavorText: The unsung hero of the whole evening.

items.name: A Mic Drop, Perfectly Timed
items.flavorText: The song ends exactly as the mic hits the floor. Iconic.

items.name: The Mic Cutting Out Mid-Verse
items.flavorText: You're still singing. Nobody can hear a word.

items.name: A Surprise Group Sing-Along, Unplanned
items.flavorText: The whole room, on their feet, for no reason anyone can explain.

items.name: Someone Crying During a Power Ballad
items.flavorText: It's just a song. It is, apparently, never just a song.

items.name: Running Way Over Your Time Slot
items.flavorText: The next group is glaring. You do not care.

items.name: A Song Choice That Starts a Small Argument
items.flavorText: 'That's not even a good song' becomes a whole debate.

items.name: The Screen Freezing on the Worst Possible Line
items.flavorText: You're now singing entirely from memory, badly.

items.name: Booking One More Hour, Nobody Wants to Leave
items.flavorText: The night was supposed to end an hour ago. Correctly, it did not.

items.name: A Jump Scare That's Perfectly Timed
items.flavorText: Right as you exhale. Right as you relax. Every time.

items.name: A Scare You See Coming From a Mile Away
items.flavorText: The floorboard creaked. You knew. You still jumped.

items.name: A Fog Machine Working Overtime
items.flavorText: Visibility: none. Atmosphere: immaculate.

items.name: Genuinely Unsettling Silence, No Scare Needed
items.flavorText: Nothing happens. That's the scariest part.

items.name: An Actor Who's Way Too Committed to the Role
items.flavorText: This is not a summer job to them. This is a calling.

items.name: An Actor Clearly on Their Phone Between Scares
items.flavorText: In character one second, texting the next.

items.name: A Chainsaw, Revved for Dramatic Effect
items.flavorText: No blade. Full volume. Full effect anyway.

items.name: An Actor Who Breaks Character to Laugh
items.flavorText: Your scream was apparently the funniest part of their shift.

items.name: A Mirror Maze You Cannot Escape
items.flavorText: You've seen your own terrified face eleven times now.

items.name: A Room That's Just Strobe Lights and Regret
items.flavorText: Disorienting. Effective. Slightly nauseating.

items.name: A Hallway That Never Seems to End
items.flavorText: You've been walking for what feels like ten minutes.

items.name: A 'Haunted' Room That's Just a Guy in a Sheet
items.flavorText: Low budget. High effort. Somehow still works a little.

items.name: A Genuine, Full-Body Scream
items.flavorText: Echoed through the entire building. No regrets.

items.name: Nervous Laughing the Whole Way Through
items.flavorText: Not actually funny. Your body disagreed.

items.name: Grabbing a Stranger's Arm by Accident
items.flavorText: You apologize. They understand completely.

items.name: Pretending You Weren't Scared at All
items.flavorText: The scream on video says otherwise.

items.name: Refusing to Go Any Further
items.flavorText: This is the exit sign. This is where you live now.

items.name: A Group That Splits Up, Regrets It Immediately
items.flavorText: The single worst decision in every horror movie, replicated live.

items.name: Buying a Photo of Your Own Terrified Face
items.flavorText: $15. Worth every cent, unfortunately.

items.name: Adrenaline That Lasts the Whole Car Ride Home
items.flavorText: Wide awake. Slightly jumpy. Completely alive.

items.name: A Genuine Nightmare That Night
items.flavorText: The clown from room three followed you home, apparently.

items.name: Immediately Wanting to Go Through Again
items.flavorText: Terrified thirty seconds ago. In line again now.

items.name: A Refund Request, Taken Very Seriously
items.flavorText: It was, in fact, exactly as advertised.

items.name: Bragging About It for Weeks After
items.flavorText: The story gets a little scarier every time you tell it.
